Q: Crop a video in Python, centered on a 16x9 video, cropped to 9x16, moviepy? A:

from moviepy import VideoFileClip

import os

inp = "/mnt/data/1000323949.mp4"

out = "/mnt/data/video_fullscreen.mp4"

clip = VideoFileClip(inp)

# Crop area permainan (menghilangkan bar hitam atas & bawah)

cropped = clip.cropped(y1=339, y2=510)

# Perbesar agar memenuhi layar vertikal video asli

final = cropped.resized(height=clip.h).with_position(("center", "center"))

final.write_videofile(out, codec="libx264", audio_codec="aac", logger=None)

print(out)

Q: FastAPI Controller/Service/Repo architecture routing with dependency injection A:

In FastAPI, you don't instantiate controller classes at startup. Instead, you define a standalone APIRouter in your router file, inject your dependencies directly into the route functions via arguments, and include that router in main.py

router.py

from typing import Annotated
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends
from .services import SomeService, get_some_service

router = APIRouter()

@router.get("/items")
async def read_items(service: Annotated[SomeService, Depends(get_some_service)]):
    return service.get_data()

main.py

from fastapi import FastAPI

from .items import router
app = FastAPI()

app.include_router(router)
